# The Four Craft Pillars

The author's negative mold, poured: each pillar names the exhausted trope it stands
against and the positive ideal that replaces it. Authors'-room doctrine — every
outline, character choice, setting choice, generation, and revision is measured
against these. Where any outside craft authority conflicts with a pillar, the pillar
wins (D-0128).

## Aesthetic sobriety

> status: ratified (D-0128)

Against shouty bravado — the hot-headed protagonist screaming motivation at the sky,
volume substituting for depth. For melancholic competence: grounded, quiet
confidence; emotion carried by a pause held a beat long, a steady breath, the
hyper-focused labor of tying a knot. Power reads cold, clinical, intellectual. The
target tone is atmospheric, meditative, profoundly adult (D-0025, D-0065, D-0066).

## Rhizomatic restoration

> status: ratified (D-0128)

Against Freytag's conquest — rising action to a violent climax, the power spike that
punches the Demon King harder (D-0010, D-0052). For the Kishōtenketsu ecology:
horizontal, exploratory, community-driven structure on the hub-and-spoke model
(D-0055); an arc's climax is a localized puzzle dissolved through empathy, pedagogy,
and rigorous logic. Not conquest — the endless, unglamorous labor of healing a broken
system ([[structure]]).

## Material sovereignty

> status: ratified (D-0128)

Against the gaze and the shallow trope — hyper-sexualized designs, cookie-cutter
races, modern identity shorthand pasted over a world that ignores material reality
(D-0056, D-0058). For grounded demography: identity forged by geography, trauma, and
economic class ([[human-variance]]); gender handled with pragmatic, period-true
fluidity and absolute respect (D-0066, D-0094); characters defined by autonomy,
intellect, and how they navigate a cruel supply chain — in thick cloaks, covered in
toxic mud.

## Earnest sincerity

> status: ratified (D-0128)

Against ironic detachment — meta winks, characters who don't take their own world
seriously, allegory as a preachy punchline (D-0030, D-0085). For true subcreation:
the world is a terrifying, breathtaking, entirely authentic reality; the allegory is
the hidden skeleton and the flesh is pure hard-magic fantasy ([[allegory]]).
Characters hold religious terror before the empire's framework, and the narrative
treats human connection, community building, and ecological preservation with
radical, un-ironic sincerity (D-0025).

## The seven tensions, ruled

> status: ratified (D-0152)

Where outside craft doctrine collides with the pillars, the collisions are recorded
in the craft knowledge base and were ruled one by one (D-0152; review record:
docs/rulings/RQ-019-craft-tensions.md). The rulings in brief: escalate
understanding, never intensity; the climax is the ten; the awe sought is
wonder-amid-ruin, never spectacle; competence is a compelling engine and may be
savored — but in Enfys it is never showy, arrogant, or noisy; every installment
moves, and relationship-deepening, richness of understanding, and emotional growth
count as movement; prose transparency is register-scoped (the narrator's quotes one
tone, most narration windowpane, future knowledge surfacing rarely — the
proof-register since ruled as the Concordance, [[magic-system]] "The proof-speech
register"); and an Event thread's restored order is
a new cycle's equilibrium — cycles within cycles, never the old order turned back.

## Early-arc legibility

> status: ratified (D-0216)

The first arc earns intimacy rather than declaring it. Across Episodes 1-3, Aalto and
Enfys remain audibly newly met: emergency alliance, functional truce, then at most
earned respect, with guardedness, friction, separate knowledge and motives, negotiated
next steps, and a credible choice to part. A lexical first-meeting line cannot excuse
the behavior of an established pair or instant found family.

Sobriety does not mean genre ambiguity. Enfys's power makes one bounded, physically
impossible consequence unmistakable early, with its causal proof or Turning stated
plainly. At the meeting, the same causal chain makes her overwhelm and temporary
disablement explicit. The result stays clinical and costly, never glowing, showy, or
bombastic.

Narrator bookends are complete and provenance-bearing. A cold-open quotation is
followed by a named-source attribution whose proper nouns resolve to eligible canon or
naming decisions. The close defaults to two to four narrator sentences and final
music: image, consequence, and next motion without audience address, stated moral,
whole-episode recap, or abrupt one-line cutoff.

## Sensory and seasonal grounding

> status: ratified (D-0217)

Action, dialogue, incident, and character do not by themselves make an opening
legible. The opening page establishes a physical place the audience can picture, at
least one sound or smell beyond the mere fact of dialogue, and the weather or season.
These details are selected and consequential rather than a room inventory: rain works
on the failing cord, smoke belongs to a particular poor hearth, and winter changes
what shelter costs.

For an audio-first story, narrator and production cues share this work. Sound may
orient and press on the scene, but it does not replace the narrator's responsibility
to make the visible environment clear, and it must not carry hidden mechanics. A
quiet opening still needs a world around the voices; an urgent opening is not exempt
because things are already happening.
